Package com.epitech.depthdiablo.combat

Class Swing

java.lang.Object
com.epitech.depthdiablo.combat.Swing
All Implemented Interfaces:
Updatable
public final class Swing extends Object implements Updatable
One melee attack in progress (GDD 1.6): the blade of a MeleeWeapon sweeps its arc around the holder, one step per tick, and hits each enemy it touches once.

The holder owns its swing and updates it each tick. The blade turns around the holder's centre, so it follows the holder if it moves during the swing.

  • Constructor Details

    • Swing

      public Swing(MeleeWeapon weapon, Character holder, float aimDegrees, Supplier<List<Entity>> targets, EventBus events)
      Starts a swing. The blade begins half an arc before the aim.
      Parameters:
      weapon - the weapon that swings
      holder - the character who swings it; the blade turns around its centre
      aimDegrees - the direction of the attack, in degrees (0 = right, 90 = up); it stays the same for the whole swing
      targets - gives the entities the blade may hit; it is read again at each tick
      events - where the swing publishes the damage it deals and the deaths it causes
      Throws:
      NullPointerException - if an argument is null
      IllegalArgumentException - if the aim is not a finite number

    • update

      public void update(long tick)
      Runs one tick of the swing: the blade moves to its next step around the holder, then hits each target it touches, once per swing. A hit that lands publishes a DamageDealt event, and an EntityDied event if it kills. A dead holder hits nothing, but its swing still runs to the end. Does nothing once the swing is over.
      Specified by:
      update in interface Updatable
      Parameters:
      tick - the number of the current logic tick
